regulatory_history.title: United States v. TikTok Inc. and ByteDance Ltd. (COPPA)
regulatory_history.body: US District Court, Central District of California
regulatory_history.notes: Brought by the Justice Department with the FTC. Pending; not proven.

procedural_note.text: On 2026-08-21 the Justice Department announced a $400 million settlement, saying there had been no determination of liability. In September 2026 the court rejected the settlement as proposed and let the department refile.

regulatory_history.title: Irish DPC fine over transfers of EEA users' data to China
regulatory_history.notes: Against TikTok Technology Limited, under GDPR Article 46(1) and transparency rules.

procedural_note.text: TikTok appealed. In June 2026 Ireland's High Court upheld the finding that TikTok broke EU privacy rules and told the regulator to reconsider its order to suspend transfers to China; a separate judgment on the fine had not yet been published.

regulatory_history.title: Joint investigation of TikTok Pte. Ltd. (PIPEDA Findings #2025-003)
regulatory_history.body: Privacy commissioners of Canada, Quebec, British Columbia and Alberta
regulatory_history.notes: Found TikTok's measures to keep children off the platform inadequate; TikTok agreed to strengthen age assurance and privacy communications.
